before.title: go to sleep
before.content: 去睡覺（sleep 為名詞）= go to bed。

after.content: go to sleep：入睡、睡著（sleep 為名詞）；go to bed：上床準備睡覺，兩者不必然表示同一時刻。

patches.reason: Distinguish the act of going to bed from falling asleep; retain title and original English tokens.
Supply Chinese for the existing exact phrase without changing the title or English.

before.title: a densely/sparsely populated city
before.content: ：居住於（常用被動）。a densely/sparsely populated city；population、populous。

after.content: a densely/sparsely populated city：人口稠密／稀少的城市。populate 意為居住於，常用被動；相關名詞 population、形容詞 populous。

patches.reason: Explain both alternatives in the existing title and preserve the related-word tokens.
